description.value: The Westbank Museum in West Kelowna preserves the cultural heritage of the Westbank area—spanning pioneer families, forestry, farming, Indigenous history, and regional conflicts—on the traditional territory of the Syilx/Okanagan Peoples. It also functions as a Visitor Information Centre, making it a practical stop for route advice as well as history. A working miniature sawmill is a standout exhibit, and admission is by donation.

address.value: 2376 Dobbin Rd (Hwy 97), West Kelowna, BC V4T 2H9

No mention of bike racks, water access, or cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site; the accessibility page's Wi-Fi entry is truncated ('Business has high-speed i...') so Wi-Fi cannot be confirmed.
